Hannah Cole: manager here — IC -> Lead promo (effective 2026-06-01) for a Brazil-based engineer. they asked: what evidence is required, how do we present BRL -> USD budgeting, and any special retro rules for BR employees?
Ravi Patel: short: Promo Evidence form + 1-page bullets mapping to rubric axes (ownership, cross-team influence, technical breadth). include 2 manager statements and 2 artifacts (PRs or dashboards). For budgeting provide USD equivalents and note FX source/date.
Lucia Santos: Brazilian specifics: submit comp-change in BRL, include USD equivalent. payroll will convert using FX on the effective date. local tax docs (CPF, FGTS paperwork) must be on file before payroll runs.
Hannah Cole: ok — manager also worried about pay parity: a peer got promoted last month within same org. can we do a provisional uplift before calibration to avoid morale issues?
Ravi Patel: provisional uplifts are allowed as temporary compression relief but require Director approval and must be clearly marked "provisional/compression relief". they are taxable and do not guarantee final level. Include a short plan to reconcile after calibration.
Lucia Santos: retro rules: standard lookback 120 days. exceptions up to 365 days are possible but need VP + finance signoff and strong justification (missed packet, system error). any retro > 18k USD triggers automatic finance review.
finance-bot: Finance note: if retro spans BR and US payrolls, we split payments by jurisdiction and apply local withholding. provide month-by-month salary history if possible to speed calculation. FX rate used will be included in approval email.
Hannah Cole: can you give manager a short pasteable checklist and a one-line comms template for the IC while we wait for calibration?
Ravi Patel: checklist (paste into Workday comp-change):
```
- Upload Promo Evidence form (1-page bullets + 2 manager statements)
- Attach 2 supporting artifacts (PR link, dashboard snapshot with dates)
- Submit comp-change in BRL and include USD equivalent (FX date = effective date)
- Include estimated retro (USD) and reason for delay if any
- If requesting provisional uplift, attach Director approval note
- Confirm employee has uploaded local tax/KYC docs (CPF, FGTS)
- Tag @people-ops and @finance-bot
- If retro > $18k or lookback >120 days, request VP+finance signoff
```
Ravi Patel: comms snippet for manager to the IC: "We submitted a promotion packet for you. Compensation figures are provisional pending calibration and approvals. Expect an update by [date]."
people-bot: Promo Evidence template v4 uploaded to #people-ops-resources and ticket #C-9201 created.
Hannah Cole: perfect  i'll send this to the manager and ask them to upload artifacts today. thanks! :raised_hands:
